description: This file contains the implementation of an asynchronous executor with retry logic, including classes and interfaces for backoff strategies, and methods to execute functions with configurable retry policies and timeouts.

classes.name: AsyncExecutorWithRetries
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to execute asynchronous functions with retry logic, supporting custom retry filters and backoff strategies.

classes.name: IBackoffProvider
classes.description: An interface defining a strategy for determining wait times between retries.

classes.name: FixedBackoff
classes.description: A backoff strategy that always returns a fixed delay between retries.

classes.name: ExponentialBackoff
classes.description: A backoff strategy that exponentially increases delay times, with configurable minimum, maximum, and step delays.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetries
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous action with retry logic based on error count, exception filter, and backoff strategy.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetries<T>
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous function returning a value, with configurable retries based on success and error filters, timeouts, and backoff strategies.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetriesHelper<T>
methods.description: Internal helper method that performs the actual retry loop, handling success and error retries, timeouts, and delays.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Method in IBackoffProvider interface to determine the delay before the next retry attempt.
